units: E. coli per 100 ml, as the layer's Units field gives them ("E. Coli/ 100 mL")
time_note: Sample times are as the layer gives them, with no time zone; read as UK local time.

claim.public_wording: Wessex Water's own river samples, analysed at the company's accredited laboratory, and the E. coli counted in each. They are not Environment Agency bathing water samples. A sample is the water at that point at the time it was taken: not today's water.
not_claimed: the water at the spot itself, where the point is not at it
that the water is safe to swim
which source the E. coli came from

who: Wessex Water: the company's own river samples, not Environment Agency statutory samples
attribution: River E. coli samples: Wessex Water Environmental Water Quality © 2026 by Wessex Water, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Selected and arranged by SwimSignal.
changes: Only E. coli, and only the sampling points linked from three SwimSignal spots, are kept.
Positions under 10 m apart are joined into one sampling point.
An operator of "NA" is read as no qualifier; "<" and ">" are kept as the lab's limits.
Each point is named after the SwimSignal spot it is linked from; the layer has no site name.

licence_check.wording: Wessex Water Environmental Water Quality © 2026 by Wessex Water is licensed under CC BY 4.0

placement_rule.how: Spot and point placed by transport.locate_pin with the spot's river; distance along the river from the shared upstream overflows' distances; an overflow upstream of one and not the other is one between them.
